ValidationRule.description: To select "Scoped" stage, the opportunity amount cannot be blank and has to be greater than $0.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Scoped'), OR(ISBLANK(Amount) || Amount <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To select the "Scoped" stage, the opportunity amount cannot be blank and has to be greater than zero.
